## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

1. Value bonds using present value and explain the inverse price-yield relationship
2. Interpret the yield curve and explain what its shape signals
3. Value stocks using the dividend discount model and price-earnings ratios
4. State the Efficient Market Hypothesis and its three forms
5. Evaluate the implications of market efficiency for investors
